airdrop_meta.name: Arbitrum (ARB) — Retroactive (historical demo)
airdrop_meta.short_description: March 2023 ARB retroactive airdrop. Demo entry — the distributor's claim window has closed, but unclaimed allocations still show as 'eligible' until the contract is fully swept. Useful as a sanity-check that the checker's RPC + contract-read pipeline works.

notes: Arbitrum Foundation token-distributor. Exposes claimableTokens(address). Wallets that never claimed still return > 0 here.
